text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Quantile score of the 9-quantile demand forecast, in points of the substation's capacity (smaller is better), by days ahead. 16 Primary substations; 73 forecast runs, one every 5 days, July 2025 to June 2026. Arms with ERA5 residuals use ERA5 weather at past times, so they are an upper bound on production. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from re-drawing whole months and seeds.'
text.tspan: Quantile score of the 9-quantile demand forecast, in points of the substation's capacity
16 Primary substations; 73 forecast runs, one every 5 days, July 2025 to June 2026. Arms
with ERA5 residuals use ERA5 weather at past times, so they are an upper bound on
Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from re-drawing whole months and seeds.
